title: kith-store: size_bytes negative check uses misleading rusqlite error variant
description: kith-store/src/lib.rs, message.rs, attachment.rs — when size_bytes < 0 the code returns rusqlite::Error::InvalidColumnType(..., Type::Integer). That variant means 'wrong SQLite storage type', not 'value out of range'. Log messages will read 'Invalid column type size_bytes of type Integer' which implies a type mismatch, not DB corruption. Fix: use FromSqlConversionFailure with a descriptive message (e.g. 'size_bytes is negative, database may be corrupted') to make the corruption sentinel legible.
